Subject: Stakeholder map & champion enablement — Folded AI (post-demo)

Hi Tom / Lydia / procurement team —

Thanks again for the demo time yesterday. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum and give Tom the materials he needs to champion internally.

Recap (from our call)
- Primary goal: reduce customer support triage time by 60% and shorten time-to-resolution across top 3 issue classes.
- Technical validation: Tom/eng to run 2-week POC against anonymized tickets, focus on latency and hallucination rate.
- Security & procurement: Lydia / procurement will validate data flows, retention, and legal terms.
- Timeline: internal decision target = end of November (Clara / CFO to sign off ideally before Thanksgiving).

Stakeholder map (as discussed)
- Champion (technical): Tom Alvarez — will run POC and own technical sign-off.
- Economic buyer: Clara Morgan, CFO — financial sign-off and pricing questions.
- Security lead: Lydia Chen, Head of Security — questionnaire, SOC2 evidence, data handling.
- Procurement: procurement@folded.ai — commercial terms and SOW.

Asks / proposed next steps
1) Tom: please share a 1–2 line internal intro you can forward to Clara + procurement that highlights the business impact (I drafted a template below).
2) Lydia / procurement: we've attached the security summary and our SOW draft; could you confirm which artifacts you need (SOC2 report, encryption attestations, regional deployments)?
3) We (Redwood) will send: (a) ROI one-pager tailored to CFOs, (b) a short champion playbook / talk tracks one-pager Tom can forward, (c) SOW draft for procurement to review.

Attachments in this message: Redwood-ROI-one-pager.pdf (exec bullets), SOW-draft-v1.docx (commercial + scope), Champion-talk-tracks.pdf (2 pgs).

Draft forward template for Tom to Clara / procurement (feel free to edit):
---
Subject: Quick intro — Redwood Inference POC for support automation
Clara / Procurement —
We ran a short demo with Redwood Inference (platform for running LLM inference with production SLAs). They showed a path to reduce ticket triage time ~60% and materially lower per-ticket cost. I'm proposing a 2-week POC to validate on our anonymized ticket set. Priyom from Redwood can share a short SOW and security artifacts.
Tom
---

Ben / Marissa / Rishi — looping you in to keep the enablement and SOW work coordinated.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
pri.yom.das@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0124
Redwood Inference — predictable, economical LLM inference

---

Hi Priyom / Tom —

Thanks for the recap. A few security/procurement items we need before any POC:
1) Current SOC2 Type II report (or summary) and date of most recent audit.
2) A network/data flow diagram that shows where tokens and any logs would be processed and stored (we prefer to see whether any PII leaves the VPC).
3) Encryption at rest + in-transit details and KMS options.
4) Data retention settings for KV cache and logs and options to configure TTL by customer.

If Redwood can share the SOC2 and a short dataflow (1 page) that would be ideal. Also can you confirm whether private deployments (VPC) are available in our AWS region (us-east-1)?

Procurement: please confirm your typical procurement lead times and whether you require redline of the SOW prior to a POC.

Happy to do a 30-minute security call Wed or Thu this week — Tom, are you available to join?

Thanks,
Lydia Chen
Head of Security | Folded AI
lydia.chen@folded.ai

Quick notes on ask items from Lydia:
- SOC2: we are SOC2 Type II certified — I've attached the SOC2 summary and a link above. We can share the full report under NDA or via secure portal; let me know preference.
- Data flow: Ben (cc'd) has a 1-page diagram; attaching as part of the champion playbook. Ben, can you confirm VPC support in us-east-1 and KMS options?
- Procurement timing: typical POC SOW is a short 2–3 week scope with limited liability terms; Clara/procurement can redline the SOW and we'll iterate.

Champion playbook highlights (for Tom to forward to Clara / procurement):
- Business impact: estimated 45–60% reduction in triage time; projected first-year savings $650k–$1.1M depending on scope (see ROI one-pager).
- Risk controls: opt-in KV cache TTL, private VPC option, per-customer data encryption + HSM-backed KMS.
- Quick ask for Clara: recommended ask is approval for a 2-week POC budget (~$25k) and a follow-on decision point to evaluate scaling.

Next steps (proposed):
1) Book security call (Lydia + Ben + Tom + Priyom) — please pick Wed 10/7 10–11 or Thu 10/8 2–3 PST.
2) Tom to forward champion note + ROI to Clara and procurement (template below).
3) Procurement to review SOW and flag any must-have redlines.
